batting.dismissal: c Mandeep Singh b HV Patel

batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b M Morkel

batting.name: SA Abbott
batting.dismissal: run out (M Morkel, Shakib Al Hasan)

balls.text: low and wide full toss, Russell throws his bat at it with some room and sends it over point for four more. Finishes on 41 off 17
quick bouncer on the leg side, it's a wide, they go for a bye as well as Russell wants strike for the last ball and Aaron gets the ball from the keeper to hit the stumps this time. Shakib is run out
punched back to the bowler, Aaron stops and has a shy at the non-striker's stumps but misses
low and wide full toss, Russell connects hard and it would have beaten third man but Iqbal Abdulla threw himself to his right to save three runs
low full toss and it's bludgeoned straight down and along the ground. Beats the bowler, beats the long on and long off fielders for four more
another edge, also going towards the sightscreen, but on the other side of the ground and that goes nearly all the way! Russell pulled, got a top edge and it went right over the keeper's head
that goes high and straight down the ground, Virat runs to his left from long on and takes a good catch on the move. Back of length it was, Yusuf slogged to the leg side and got a leading edge
beats fine leg for four! It was back of length and well outside leg, Russell stayed back and pulled it late off the hips to get four fine down leg
right in the block hole, Russell digs it back and Harshal jumps to stop it with both hands
short of length outside off, Yusuf slaps it straight down the ground. Oh, there's another fumble and it's Virat this time. But they get only one
slower bouncer, Russell misses and is out of the crease briefly. DK gets a direct hit and KKR take a single after that

leading edge off the full toss goes high in the air, cover point and point getting under it and both of them leave it for the other - Aaron and Abbott! It was an easy catch but probably nobody called for it
slower ball? Doesn't matter! Russell picks it and goes down on a knee to launch it over the long on boundary a few rows in the stands for a massive six
tries the yorker and Russell punches it to long on for one
slower and fuller, it's in the zone for Russell and he smashes it off the middle of the bat over cover to send it all the way
follows it with a bouncer and Russell fails to connect
too full and much closer to the stumps, this one is slammed down the ground, past the bowler and past long off for four
that's a wide yorker outside off, he looks to dig it out but misses
length delivery around off, punched down to long on for one
136kph, length delivery just outside off, pushed wide of the bowler for a quick single
slower offcutter coming in from outside off, Andre pushes it to point for one
short ball and that's way too wide outside off, Russell reaches out and gets a thick bottom edge fine on off for four
swing and a miss first ball for the length delivery outside off

so much is happening here, Pandeyji is run out at the end of it! He pushed the slower ball back to the bowler, who got a hand to it and the ball deflected towards cover. Pandey is more than halfway down the pitch but Yusuf has done a Gayle - he doesn't move - and Kohli gets an underarm direct hit at keeper's end by the time Pandey dives back

not long before he targets that leg-side boundary, but he's caught in the deep! He went back in the crease to whip that short of length ball to the long-leg boundary, gets some distance but Mandeep takes it right at the boundary. Harshal roars, he has some whiskers too
stays back to let it turn and he cuts it late from outside off to deep point for two by the time Gayle gets there
on the other side now - sweeps him against the turn to deep fine leg for one
bit too full as Yuzi has been pitching them up, Surya connects with an inside out drive and finds the gap beautifully in the covers for four
takes a step down, Yuzi pitches it wide with some turn, Surya misses but gets his back foot back in time
leans forward and pushes the ball from outside off to backward point for one
sweeps the length delivery from middle against the turn to deep fine leg for one
smokin'! Gets the short ball again and he clobbers it over Gayle at midwicket for a crackin' four
that's a clever shot for four! He made room, saw width as well, and instead of hitting it hard, he merely used the pace of the ball to run it past backward point for four
in the air again and lands safely this time too! Short of length towards the batsman, he pulls and finds the gap between deep fine leg and deep backward
short and quick, Surya connects and uses the pace of the ball to ramp it to third man region for a one-bounce four
that goes just over the stumps! Surya shuffled too much towards off, looked to whip it like Viv and missed
makes room, is beaten by pace and chips it in the air towards cover for one
waits for the ball to turn from around off, it nearly sneaks through as Surya defends it late to slip
slightly slower outside off, Pandey leans forward and pushes to backward point for one
this one is straighter and fuller, he smashes it straight down the ground with a straight bat for four
good turn and slightly slower outside off, Pandeyji drives and misses
it's high, it's not off the middle of the bat, and he's taken at deep midwicket. GG slog-sweeps the fullish delivery from middle and leg, it goes high enough for Mandeep to take it easy in the deep
comes down to take it on the full and works it with the spin to deep midwicket for two
pitched outside leg, looks to work it fine to fine leg but gets a leg bye
shuffles across a bit and defends the ball towards backward point for a quick single. AB tries a direct hit but misses. Second run for the overthrow as well
bouncer over the batsman's head and it's high enough to be called wide
there's width, there's the short ball and GG cuts it fiercely past point and wide of third man for four! That sped the boundary in no time
looks to guide the short ball outside off to third man, gets a bottom edge and a single
mid on is in, Pandey knows that and he makes room to smash the delivery over that fielder by making some room for four
bangs in the short ball which GG defends on the leg side and he gets to his fifty. It's his 25th in IPL and he's the first one to get there. Raina right behind him on 24
full on off now with some flight, driven straight back to Chahal
flighted and full on middle, defended back to the bowler
fullish on the pads, tucked on the leg side behind square for one
flighted and full on off, driven down to long on easily for one
leans forward and works the ball with the turn from off stump to short fine leg
charges down and drives uppishly on leg, inner edge goes to deep midwicket and they get two
bouncer angled in, Pandeyji made room for that and let it go
run-out chance first ball! GG defends the ball towards the keeper and calls for it, Pandey responds with a dive at the keeper's end and luckily for him there was no direct hit
in the air again and the catch is taken this time, at long on! Robbie slapped the short ball from outside off down the ground. The ball was in the air for some time and became an easy catch for Sammy
attacks the length delivery on the off side by going inside out, gets two to find the gap between deep cover and third man
room outside off, GG clears his front foot and slashes it over point for one
fullish around off, cross-bat slog goes to deep square leg for one
flighted way too much, it's a full toss and GG swats it between long and deep midwicket in the gap. AB runs from long on to his left, slides as well abut the ball goes past him
tries the slog sweep for the ball well outside off, but this one was slower through the air and GG missed it completely
tossed up on middle and leg, turned to deep midwicket with the wrists for one
comes down the track and cuts the ball late to point for a single
length delivery around off, punched off the back foot to point
short of length on middle, Robbie goes back and works it to leg
long on is a bit wide, the ball is not, GG walks towards the off stump and lofts it straight down the ground to the long-on boundary for four
swing and a miss for the length delivery outside off
loud, confident appeal from Sammy but it looked turned down and they take a leg bye. It came in sharply from well outside off as Robbie looked to work it on leg, struck just outside off maybe
full outside off stump, driven nicely to sweeper cover for one
fullish on the pads, tucked away behind square on leg for one
just outside off, pushed down to mid off for one

AB de Villiers has fluffed a straightforward catch, what all the IPL brings to you! Short ball, GG pulled it from the middle of the bat and AB was waiting at deep midwicket, but the ball simply popped out of his hands. He can't believe it either!
some room outside off, Robbie drives it just wide of mid off and gets one
short ball this time and it comes in, Robbie mistimes the pull to midwicket
nice and tight length delivery outside off, pushed back to the bowler
angled across the batsman outside off, he runs it down to third man too
bit outside off and Robbie guides it nicely to third man for one
better delivery on middle and leg, no room and GG defends it to midwicket
GG's bat comes down late on the quick bouncer, top edge and what do top edges get you in T20s? One-bounce four
outside off this time, GG guides it late towards backward point
bangs it in short, GG hops to defend on off but Robbie is nearly halfway down the pitch. Hello! Aaron throws it at non-striker's as if Mohammad Irfan is there to collect it
touch fuller and Robbie makes the call this time, pushes it down to mid off and sets off for the single straightaway
quick and just short of length around off, Robbie defends it back
inside egde onto the pads, the ball goes behind towards the keeper and GG makes Robbie run for a cheeky single
angling away from off stump, guides it late to third man for one
length delivery right on the middle stump, blocked back this time
fuller and straighter, much better, GG defends it back
short of length on the pads, there's no use bowling there to GG. He uses the pace of the ball and tucks it late off his legs to the fine leg boundary
some room outside off and he cuts it late to third man for one
quick bouncer on the leg stump, GG ducks under it in the nick of time
strikes on the third attempt and slogs the full delivery on the pads to the cow corner
good short ball just outside off, GG wanted to ramp it over the slip region but missed it by a whisker
poor lbw appeal for a ball that pitched outside leg and was going down further as GG looked to flick it in the air
run out chance - Robbie slashes this one towards point, AB gets a fumble and Mandeep collects to throw at non-strikers' but Uthappa is safe
starts with a shortish one around middle and off, GG defends it close to himself to steal a single
didn't start with a boundary, but ends with one. Robbie is given room again outside off and he frees his arms with a well-placed drive past point for four more
short ball just outside off, Robbie looks to guide it over the keeper but misses
outside leg now and it's easily worked to midwicket for one
angled in towards the stumps from length, driven down through GG's legs to mid-on. He tried to get out of the way but got hit
it's outside off and well outside off, short as well and Robbie crunches it between cover point and cover for a cracking four, on the up
angled away just outside off, GG looks to drive it late and gets a bottom edge for one
starts this over with a wide down leg
tucks the length delivery off the pads easily to midwicket for one
keeps a bit low as GG stays back for the short of length delivery and it goes to cover off the defence
short again, that pull sent the ball in the air but it landed safely. Looks like Robbie was a bit late on the shot, but got enough to send it behind square
bangs it in short to Uthappa too, he wants to work it to leg but doesn't time it well and the ball goes back to the bowler
short ball now swinging in, GG goes on his toes and works it to deep square leg for one
lofted out of the park for six! This one was pitched up on the pads with some inswing and GG smacked it to the cow corner boundary with a big follow through
short of a length, on off, drops it at his feet, and rushes through for one
good bouncer. Gambhir doesn't like them. He is late into the hook. Flies over his right shoulder
half-volley, just outside off, driven hard, but straight to mid-off
short of a length, outside leg, there is an appeal, a ploy to stop the umpire calling a wide, and it has worked
another length ball, this time pushed wide of mid-off for one
wide length ball, Uthappa leans into it, drives with a slightly open face, beats cover-point, and the outfield does the rest
forward-defensive for another single
and more gifts for KKR. Pushed towards mid-on, they call early, and make an easy single, but there is an overthrow allowing them a second
swing this time, but headed down leg, and clipped away for one
another misfield. A half-volley, which excites the bowler because Gambhir has played across its line. He manages to get enough bat on it, but HarshaL Patel has provided it a gateway at midwicket
on a length, accurate, defended to leg for a single
short of a length, outside off, opens the face, and Abu Nechim has made a meal of a regulation stop at third man. Abbott manages a smile
no need for the last over - that's finished with a four! Nechim made room, got another short ball and went hard at it to get a thick upper edge to send the ball fine on the off side for four
back of length towards the batsman now, he gets some bat towards short fine leg for an easy single

is that another run out, Robbie thinks he's got him! Harshal played the short of length ball towards third man by opening the face of the bat, the fielder ran in hard, they want two, the throw is accurate, Harshal dives and replays suggest he made it
makes room to slash at the ball and finds GG at point, but they take a quick single

another meaty blow, superb fielding in the deep from Pandey and Gayle is run out, would you believe it! He middled it for the cow corner boundary, where Pandey fell over the boundary while taking the catch but made sure he threw the ball back in just before that. The batsmen settled for one initially and realised a little late there was time for a second. Gayle is not completely fit and is slow to come back for the second. Accurate throw and he's well short, what a faux pas
doesn't matter where you bowl to him now - it was on length and he clobbered it over long on for six!
no, he's not going to block it! Got a full delivery and smashed it straight down the ground into the sightscreen with a straight bat. Clean and confident strike!
comes down to smash the ball back to the bowler, Narine gets a hand to it
slightly quicker on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket and he wants two more but won't get more than one
he's not only about power - paddles the ball fine down leg with the turn for two in the gap to fine leg
on the other side of the same fielder - goes to Shakib's left now as he sweeps the ball from leg and even takes one hand off just after hitting the shot
picks the gap by pulling the short ball from leg off the back foot to the wide long-on boundary for four. Shakib is placed there but it beats him
fullish outside off and Gayle drives uppishly, gets a leading edge and it beats Morkel at cover. He gets a single to keep strike
full toss and that will definitely go for six. Same region - midwicket boundary and right from the middle of the bat. Massive strike
and why's he denying the singles? For this - got a full delivery and tonked it with the slog sweep from the middle of that bat for a huge six
nearly in the block hole again, muscled down to long on but denies the single to Harshal Patel yet again
in the block hole from Shakib, he pushes it to midwicket but keeps strike
massive wide down the leg side

run out chance, gone to the third umpire! Gayle worked the ball towards sweeper cover in the deep, they had no choice but to go for two with the asking rate. But Abbott fell couple of inches short with that accurate throw
another drop, it's Gayle's again and it's from Morkel again! He slog swept the fullish ball from middle behind square and Morkel got to it but could not hold on as he was on the move. Turning point
slightly flatter from outside off, pulled to deep midwicket for one
turning in from outside off, pushed back to the bowler
flat and coming in, worked to the leg side for one
fuller outside off, that;s a big six, straight down the ground. Not many places the ball can go to if you pitch it up to him
outside off on just short of length, Gayle goes back and pulls it to pick the gap between long on and deep midwicket for a four
fullish outside off, he drives and gets a thick outside edge to short third man for one
full on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
another stumping chance, this one goes to the third umpire no idea why! Sammy came well out of his crease, got beaten in the air and Robbie whipped the bails off in no time to stump him
very flat and quick outside off, muscled down to long off
wider outside off and he punches it off the back foot to sweeper cover
on length outside off, he defends it back

run out chance missed by KKR! Sammy helped the ball with the turn to short fine leg and set off for the single, Gayle started a bit late and the throw was accurate at keeper's end but Robbie didn't collect the ball
on middle and leg now, Gayle looks to defend and gets a thick outside edge on off for one
beaten again as Narine pitches it around off, drawing Gayle forward and he misses again
carrom ball outside off and Sammy plays it away from the body to deep point for one
slightly shorter and Gayle pulls it off the back foot to long on, that's his fifty off 37 balls
beats him outside off with the offspinner that goes past the outside edge
stays back and lofts the ball after it turns to deep midwicket
hits that one from outside off with some power to sweeper cover for one
flatter outside off, punched down to long off
too short, too flat, and Gayle goes to the back foot to muscle such power into the ball that it goes a few rows back into the stands at the cow corner boundary
pitched up on middle stump, pushed into the covers
whips the ball after the turn and against it to deep midwicket
full toss to Gayle, guess what happened! It was straight on the stumps, and Gayle also sent it straight over the bowler's head for a powerful six
slower through the air on leg, Gayle defends it back
waits for the ball to turn and just beats midwicket with a punch
goes back and works the ball from outside leg to deep midwicket for one
stays back to push the ball from outside off to long off
dropped by Morkel, though it was a tough one! Gayle pulled it to deep midwicket, Morkel took some time to react and went forward but couldn't hold on to it

he wanted another one but is beaten by the change in pace and is stumped so fast by Robbie before AB can look back. Came down the track for the ball that was outside off, it was much flatter and went under AB's horizontal bat as he missed it. Robbie does the best, Cariappa doesn't celebrate his maiden IPL wicket at all
on the other side now, six more, can someone stop him? Full and towards the stumps, he got under it and tonked it over long on. Everyone's a spectator!
some flight and it's pitched up, AB goes down on a knee and absolutely smashes that with a lot of power to beat sweeper cover. Four more
outside leg and turning in, pushed to deep midwicket for one
comes down to smash the full ball but manages to get it only to long on
pithced up outside off and AB makes some room to drive in nicely inside out for a beautiful four
comes down again and smashes the low full toss to deep midwicket
dances down and connects this time - gone over the midwicket boundary! He had been trying that for a while and finally connected by hitting it with the turn
just around leg and worked off the back foot to deep midwicket
tries to whip the ball with the turn to leg, only gets a leg bye
well outside leg and easily helped to midwicket for one
comes down and slogs the length ball with the turn to deep midwicket
full toss on off stump, punched down the ground and it deflects off Gayle's left shoe to long off. For a second it looked like Gayle kicked it away
gives him the charge, chases the ball outside off but misses it
drives it uppishly but he finds the gap right between cover and mid off to send it crashing for four. A lot of them thought there was a chance, but it pierced the gap
that's short and quick, ABD sways out of the line of the ball to let it go
well outside leg again and this time he works it to midwicket for one
lbw appeal again as Gayle goes on the back foot to defend, the ball moves away after pitching outside leg and Gayle got an outside edge to beat the keeper for four
why, why would he do that? He just hit a six and now tries to reverse sweep the ball that pitches on middle stump. The ball is turning in and he's playing the off-stump line, loses his leg stump
comes down the track, takes it on the full and lofts it straight down the ground for a six!
bit of flight on the stumps, worked to midwicket
knocks the stumps, DK misses it completely! It pitched well outside off and DK went back in the crease to cut it late but he got too far away from it
loud appeal for lbw as Gayle slog-sweeps and misses but that one pitched outside leg for sure. Good decision. Maybe inside edge too
pitches just outside leg and deflects off the pad for two leg byes down the leg side
full and wide outside off, driven uppishly and powerfully down to long off for one
short ball is pulled in the air and it bounces once before reaching deep midwicket
angled in sharply with some pace and DK takes it on the pads, not picking the pace properly
short ball towards leg and DK pulls it fine down the leg side, gets it off the glove as he's beaten by pace and gets four
slower offcutter towards off, DK watches carefully and defends it into the covers
length delivery on the stumps, pushed down to mid on
flighted on middle, works it to leg with soft hands and DK forces Gayle for a single
full and flat on the stumps, clubbed down the ground for one
fullish on the pads, Gayle lofts it in the air, it's going towards mid on but goes just over him for four
on length on middle and leg, Gayle defends it back
welcome to T20s, harsh welcome from Gayle as he slams the full and flighted straight delivery for six near the sight screen
slightly full around off, pushed into the covers
back of length outside off, DK goes on his toes to defend it to cover point

loud appeal for a catch down leg and the finger's gone up, Kohli is gone! Good pace and bounce for the short ball as it was going down leg, Kohli pulled, got some glove before Uthappa took a good catch
fullish and wide, driven along the ground to point with a forward lean
towards the pads from outside leg, slightly slower at 129kph, worked towards midwicket for one
bludgeoned down the ground! He put his front foot out of the way and clobbered that straight over Morkel's head for four
hops back for the back of length ball and works it to deep midwicket for one
hits him on the pad with the carrom ball this time, doesn't give any room and it goes to short fine leg. No time for a run
beats him outside off with some turn by drawing him forward with the length delivery
fullish on the pads, tucked straight to midwicket
shorter and wider down leg, Gayle wants to swat it off the back foot but it deflects off his pad fine down leg for four leg byes
doesn't move much and defends the ball from leg stump to leg side
Kohli goes back to let it turn and works to leg for one
did he middle that? Didn't look like, and he doesn't need to with that mammoth bat he's carrying. Short ball he got, pull he gave and sent it over mid on for a one-bounce four
quick and short, Gayle pulls and misses as it angles across him
comes down again and lofts it in the gap from off stump over the mid off fielder. GG cuts it back with a slide and saves one
fullish outside off now, driven with a forward lean to point
smoked for six! short ball around off, and as if Kohli was expecting it, he pulled it with utter disdain to the midwicket boundary
pressure is mounting - Kohli dances down the track with some room for the swing outside off and misses
turning in from outside off, he goes back and jabs it to leg for one
wider outside off and it doesn't turn much, Kohli goes after it and gets a bottom edge
bit of flight outside off, it turns away and Gayle pushes it tentatively into the covers
shuffles across a bit and helps the ball with the turn to leg for one
goes back this time with minimal footwork and pushes it down to mid off for one
slightly slow and on length on middle, turns away a little as Gayle leans forward to defend
slightly tentative defence for the back of length ball outside off, Kohli gets an edge
fuller and much towards middle and leg, pushed to mid on off the back foot
slightly closer to off stump and another solid defence from Kohli
presses forward and defends the ball from outside off into the covers
length delivery on middle and leg, worked wide of mid on for one
low and wide full toss, driven straight to cover point
